articleTitle: The Implementation of Smart Contract via Blockchain Technology in Supply Chain Management: A Case Study from The Automotive Industry in Turkey
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: Blockchain Technology, underlined as the most revolutionizing innovation after the internet, is still in the growth phase and waits for the practitioners to enlighten its productivity promises. In the current environment, volatile profits require a more digitalized work experience and competitive advantages to get ahead in such a highly competitive automotive industry and innovative applications that lead to more simplified operation management. Accordingly, this paper aims to present a case study via use cases in which Blockchain has been used and smart contract as the sought-out innovation and its application for the digitized spare parts disposal legal process. Blockchain Technology in the automotive sector is discussed by focusing on the supply management process of an automotive company's processes in Turkey. Blockchain technology is expected to develop and simplify spare parts-related transactions in the automotive industry, which deals with more than 500K stock keeping units per company. Paper presents the current, future, and ideal states of spare parts transactions with Blockchain adoption. The implemented application enables the development of an enterprise-level blockchain platform with hyper-ledger fabric as an open-source. The distributed ledger technology provides a smart contract system between actors of the existed supply chain process. The study aims to show the potential of Blockchain Technology in delivering a high degree of competitive advantage especially for automotive service providers with regards to its features related to providing security, transparency, traceability, cost reduction, more efficient data storage in dense supply based industries.

articleTitle: Blockchain-based Electronic Evidence Storage and Efficiency Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: Electronic evidence is the electronic data generated based on electronic technology and stored in digital form. Aiming at the problems of data authenticity and integrity in the traditional storage methods of electronic evidence, and the existing blockchain storage schemes fail to give good consideration to the storage cost and efficiency. This paper proposes a model for electronic evidence storage, which uses directed acyclic graph to optimize the efficiency of on-chain storage of electronic evidence. Experimental results show that the proposed model is effective and practical.

articleTitle: Research on Web Log Data Mining Technology Based on Optimized Clustering Analysis Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: With the continuous development and progress of network and information technology, facing the rapid growth of Web service resources, how to obtain the knowledge people need through existing server resources? Web mining technology can realize the mining and discovery of new knowledge from fixed resources. Log mining can discover customer interests and hobbies through Internet users' access behavior, so that the website can provide more humane services. A comprehensive understanding of log mining related technologies is of great help to achieve user clustering. The main analysis of the Web log user clustering in this paper is to establish a user session sequence matrix based on the data preprocessing of the log file, and then perform cluster analysis on it, and finally perform related applications.

articleTitle: Improvement and Comparison of Traditional CNN and SVM Classification Based on Hog Descriptor in Pedestrian Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: This paper first briefly introduces and compares several traditional convolutional neural networks. Next, it presents the Hog (Histogram of oriented gradient) Descriptor. Then, it mainly discusses and compares the differences between HOG + SVM algorithm and traditional convolutional neural network in the field of pedestrian detection. And finally, it describes how to improve the traditional HOG + SVM with Non- Maximum Supp and bootstrap method. Experiments show that the accuracy of the improved HOG + SVM algorithm is much higher than that of the traditional CNN, and the time required is not much

articleTitle: Research on Decision-Making of EMUs Maintenance Based on Triangular Fuzzy multi-Attribute
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: Chinese Electric Multiple Units (EMUs) is known for its highest quantity, high operation density, high speed and long routing which bring great convenience to railway passengers as well as unprecedented pressure on safety. To ensure EMUs operational safety, current maintenance system is adopted as 'Mainly based on planning preventive maintenance, supplemented by post-maintenance‘. The maintenance system basically meets the needs of Chine high-speed rail operation safety, but some problems still exist such as insufficient maintenance and over-maintenance, resulting in low EMUs online rates and high maintenance costs. When faults occur or are predicted during operation of EMUs, various factors are needed to be fully considered, and the most reasonable maintenance method should be quickly decided to improve the efficiency and quality of EMUs maintenance, and to reduce maintenance costs. In the article, a fuzzy multi-attribute method based on Triangular Fuzzy number is adopted to comprehensively analyze the impact of various factors including EUM condition, fault history and maintenance conditions, to select the optimal schemes from a group of limited faults disposal schemes, therefore maintenance decision-making suggestions are proposed. The method has had a trial in the EMUs Prognostics and Health Management (PHM) System. The method can provide reasonable disposal schemes when faults occur or are predicted and 78% of the suggestions are the same as the actual measures, which shows that the method is effective and has a certain application prospect.

articleTitle: Conception of Applying Sovereign Blockchain Technology to Improve Tax Credit Management in Guangdong Province, China
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: Presently, several problems still exist in tax credit management including inadequate collection of credit information, opaque process of credit rating evaluation and adjustment, insufficient pertinence of credit publicity results, and low social application degree of credit evaluation results. The application of blockchain technology can perfectly match the needs of information management because it has several advantages such as decentralization, openness and transparency, non-tampering and traceability, and intelligent contract mechanism. Therefore, the technology can be used to achieve the flow of information data assets and privacy protection, and has good applicability to solve the problems faced in the current tax credit management process. This paper aims at solving the existing problems in tax credit management based on the analysis of the characteristics of the blockchain technology and the compliance of tax credit management using Guangdong Province as an example. The paper suggests the specific idea of applying the sovereign blockchain technology to improve the level of tax credit management.

articleTitle: Cross-hospital Access of Electronic Medical Records on Blokckchain Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: The situation that patients' electronic medical records are stored in different hospitals is a major barrier to speedy access of treatment history in emergency. In addition, traditional storage systems built on centralized databases suffer from unauthorized data access and tampering. Blockchain technology can provide a distributed and safe storage and secure data sharing platform for encrypted medical data with a specialized access control schema which is similar to the CP-ABE schema. This paper describes the preliminary work on a blockchain network design that can store and share electronic medical records with cross-hosnital access schema.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Evolutionary Approach to Solve University Course Allocation Problem
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: This paper discusses various types of constraints, difficulties and solutions to overcome the challenges regarding university course allocation problem. A hybrid evolutionary algorithm has been defined combining Local Repair Algorithm and Modified Genetic Algorithm to generate the best course assignment. After analyzing the collected dataset, all the necessary constraints were formulated. These constraints manage to cover the aspects needed to be kept in mind while preparing clash free and efficient class schedules for every faculty member. The goal is to generate an optimized solution which will fulfill those constraints while maintaining time efficiency and also reduce the workload of handling this task manually. The proposed algorithm was compared with some base level optimization algorithms to show the better efficiency in terms of accuracy and time.

articleTitle: Optimizing Water Resources Allocation and Hydropower Generation for Supporting Reservoir Management
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: In this paper, a multi-stage fuzzy stochastic programming (MFSP) method is developed to optimize water resources allocation under uncertainties. MFSP method can not only deal with uncertainties expressed as fuzzy sets and probabilistic distributions, but also provide a linkage between the pre-regulated policies and the associated economic implications. Four hydropower generation targets, three inflow levels and five violation risk levels are analyzed. articleTitle: Picking Scheme Optimization Model and Algorithm Based on Random Storage of Goods in Batch
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: Aiming at the optimization of picking scheme under the conditions of goods random storage in batch, on the premise of giving priority to the goods with early batch, comprehensively considering the impact of storage unit selection on picking path, the storage unit selection and picking path were optimized as a whole. By introducing the batch factor, the picking path length was weighted. Taking the minimum total weight of the picking path length as the goal and the storage unit and path selection as the decision variables, a 0–1 programming model for the overall optimization of storage unit selection and picking path was established. Constrained by the maximum picking ability of the picker, the concepts of picking sequence and maximum picking subsequence were proposed, and a simulated annealing algorithm to solve the model was designed. At last, an example was given to prove the proposed method can minimize the picking path length while selecting goods with early batches.

articleTitle: Research on the Configuration Management of Complex Equipment Based on Identity Resolution
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: Identity resolution system is the primary technical research problem to set up the data collection capability of industrial internet, and the configuration resolution of complex assets is an application difficulty. To implement the particular requirements of complex equipment configuration management, an industry-oriented identity resolution architecture and the configuration resolution service were designed. In accordance with the technical information management of high-speed train, corresponding handle structures was proposed to describe the configuration structure and related components information of EMU (Electric Multiple Unit). A distributed processing algorithm for configuration resolution and the hit-ratio evaluation method of handle service sites was proposed. The performance, stability, and resolution consistency of the handle system in this paper are proved by experiments, which is also great significant to the intelligent identity applications in other industries.

articleTitle: Applying Machine Learning to Improve Collection and to Reduce Write-Offs in Utilities
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: Up to 2% of utilities' bills become bad debt and write-offs, meaning tens of billion dollars annually. Collection of unpaid invoices is a complex task for power, gas and water companies that continuously search for improvement. The goal of our research was to investigate utilities' payment behavior and how they respond to collection actions, in order that could be possible optimize the capital allocation to recover more revenue. Therefore, we selected 43 features, none external to the utility, and applied machine learning algorithms to 300 thousand utility's customers with unpaid invoices in the last 3 years to evaluate results. For this, we proposed a framework for the scoring models of default prediction, spontaneous payments, and payment through response to collection actions. The approach was divided into three phases consisting of carrying out the pre-processing of data, feature selection and evaluation of the approach through AUC, Accuracy and ROC curve. Our work achieved an AUC of 0.9222 and Accuracy of 0.8696 for payment propensity in the next 30 days (similar results for next 60 and 90 days). Comparing to the Financial industry, a study that applied machine learning techniques to predict payment delinquency for bank loans, using 345 features, achieved AUC of 0.8748 with Deeper MLP with sigmoid and Accuracy of 0.8650 with XGBoost, after NAP algorithm for feature selection [1].

articleTitle: Research on Blockchain Reshaping Integrated Enterprise Financial Information System in Digital Era
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: In the era of fast-developing digital economy, the management systems and models of existing manufacturing enterprises are facing many challenges. As an emerging underlying technology of the Internet, blockchain has been widely used in many business fields. Based on the digital transformation of manufacturing enterprises, this paper discusses how to reshape the production and operation processes of manufacturing enterprises, build internal and external value chain networks, and improve the financial integration information systems by taking advantage of the characteristicss of blockchain technology from the firm value delivering and transferring perspective. The study provides a theoretical basis and empirical reference for the application of blockchain technology in manufacturing enterprises.

articleTitle: An Empirical Analysis and Research on the Prediction of Stock Trends Based on the MLP Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: With the rapid development of China's economy and the continuous expansion of securities trading scale, stock market prediction is crucial to investment institutions and individuals, but market volatility and non-stationary characteristics make prediction difficult. To predict the future growth of stocks as accurately as possible with existing data, this paper selects ARIMA based on derivation of the logical relationship and mathematical relationship related to each function, and uses Python language to perform difference, white noise inspection, order determination, and solution steps, thereby predicting and perfecting incomplete data. To predict the stock market in the next year, first, we analyze and fit the relevant data of the Shanghai Stock Exchange in the past year, establish an MLP neural network model based on Tensor Flow deep learning framework. Taking 80% data of 8 stocks in the data set with greater influence in different fields as the training set, and 20% as the verification set, model reliability is verified. Secondly, the trained sample is used to predict the trend of stocks in the next year, thereby predicting the future stock trend. Finally, diversified analysis is made on the trained future data. Then, feasibility recommendations and investment strategies for stock investment as well as strategies for avoiding investment risks are put forward.

articleTitle: Using Hyperledger Fabric to Reduce Fraud in International Trade
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: Due to the physical distances and different global customs and laws, international trade is fraught with risk; a significant threat involves falsified or fraudulent letters of credit (LC) and/or bills of lading (BoL). We describe how federated and permissioned blockchains are more suitable to detect and mitigate fraudulent behavior than permissionless ones. We propose a framework based on Hyperledger Fabric that can ensure that the involved entities are valid, transactions on these goods are correctly ordered, documents are verifiable, and they properly represent the goods on the BoL Next, we discuss three scenarios that illustrate fraud in international trade and describe how our proposed framework can address each of these concerns. Last, we discuss some challenges in implementing our proposed framework and discuss future steps in our research.

articleTitle: Web Service Classification Based on Reinforcement Learning and Structured Representation Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: In recent years, the rapid growth of the number of web services on the Internet has made it difficult to discover services from a large number of web services and classify them efficiently, which poses a huge challenge for users to provide appropriate web services. The existing web service classification technology has problems such as sparse description text, insufficient consideration of attribute information and structural relationships, so the accuracy of web service classification can be further improved. In response to the above problems, this paper first proposes an information distillation model based on reinforcement learning. Reinforcement learning is introduced to delete redundant information and retain valid information. Then, the classification network classifies the distilled information and determines the reward based on the prediction result. Then, the reward is fed to reinforcement learning for gradient update and the classification network is updated inversely according to the classification result. It can effectively alleviate the inherent noise caused by the introduction of the attention mechanism. It can also learn classification tasks by identifying important words or task-related structures without displaying structural annotations (ie, artificially building models). Through comparative experiments on the real data set of Programmable Web, the results show that the proposed model achieves better results on the benchmark data set than other methods.

articleTitle: Utilizing Machine Learning to Reconnect Potential Customers of the E-Commerce Industry
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: In competitive markets, it is costly to attract new customers in the business as they already have a wide customer base; that being the case, businesses spend a healthy budget to reconnect with customers they have had transactions with in the past. As we are approaching towards post-pandemic, there is a need to increase the profitability of the businesses and retain their customer base. To increase customer turnover and re-engagement, this paper focuses on the implementation of intelligent business practices using machine learning and neural networks. The paper focuses on analyzing the customer behavior based on their purchase behavior and purchase transactional values for customer retention. The division is done to identify the customers who are profitable to the business and customers who are likely to churn for a number of reasons. In this paper, we proposed a Multi-layer perceptron (MLP) to segment the customers according to Recency, Frequency, and Monetary Value (RFM) methodology and customer profitability index. The result of MLP was compared with K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) and Support Vector Machine (SVM) as the later models have been widely used. Additionally, Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM) models have been implemented for primary customer classification and sales prediction. The prediction model is an attempt to reduce the financial loss on marketing campaigns for re-engagement of customers in the business. The dataset used was retrieved from Cardinal Care BD.

articleTitle: The Design of Reputation System for Blockchain-based Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: Federated learning (FL) is a new solution to fulfill machine learning (ML) in a decentralized manner. In FL, a group of participants train their local models using their private data, and then upload the locally trained models to a central server that completes the model aggregation process. Compared with the traditional ML that needs to upload private data of the participants to a server for a centralized training, FL protects the data privacy of participants. However, the existing FL has several drawbacks: FL relies to a large extent on a single central server that takes the risk of single point of failure; it lacks a fair and effective reward system to prevent malicious participants from damage the learning process. To overcome these drawbacks, this paper proposes a new FL system based on blockchain (BC). With BC, we introduce a voting-based reputation mechanism to guarantee that the locally trained models from effective FL participants (other than malicious FL participants) can be selected to improve the efficiency of model aggregation. Besides that, we combine the reputation system with a reward mechanism to dynamically adjust the reward shares that can be fairly allocated to the participants. This can attract more FL participants to participate in the learning process, so that the system can run stably for a long time. The experimental results show that our system can achieve more efficient FL learning and can also defend against malicious attacks to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Lightning Insurance: A Fast Claim, High Accuracy Insurance Platform Based on Blockchain Technology and NASNET Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: Insurance is a financial instrument with a long histo-ry and conducive to social development. With the modernization process, centralized insurance companies gradually replaced mu-tual insurance, completing insurance design, insurance sales, and claims review. A large number of cases of fraudulent insurance and insurance companies delaying the application of reasonable claims, resulting in the buyer's distrust of the insurance company and the insurance company's distrust of the purchaser. Through blockchain and deep learning, this paper constructs an insurance business alliance, which links the mature and stable intelligent, discriminating scenarios into the entire insurance system, thus reducing the long redundant nuclear insurance process to the scope of machine identification and minute-level insurance. At the same time, a number of underwriting companies combined through blockchains can achieve very high accuracy rates with limited algorithm accuracy. It enhances the user experience of claimants who are in urgent need of financial assistance, thereby significantly enhancing user trust, in order to increase people's trust in insurance products from a macro perspective, and thus promote the popularization of insurance in China.

articleTitle: Blockchain Technology Applications in Retail and Insurance Sectors: Cases from Suning and PingAn
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: Blockchain is a shared, immutable ledger that facilitates the process of recording transactions and tracking assets in a business network. As a novel technology, blockchain has a broad impact on various business practices. China is leading blockchain technology development all over the world. This paper studies the blockchain technology applications in the retail and insurance sectors in China. Specifically, we compared the similarities and differences of blockchain implementations between two typical cases-Suning and Ping An. Our research results provide meaningful implications and insights for blockchain practitioners who are keen in leveraging blockchain technologies in their businesses.

articleTitle: Stochastic Simulation for Assessing DLT Application Design Quantitatively
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: The distributed ledger technology (DL T) secures data and the execution of program code in a decentral network. This enables new forms of business cooperation without the need of central intermediaries. However, the design process of DLT applications is not a simple task. The engineering process is burdened with the responsibility of choosing a suitable distributed ledger implementation, that will cope with the environmental limitations and transaction loads. The nature of the distributed ledger technology makes an exchange of the technology base at a later point expensive and complicated, since every network participant needs to agree to the change. That makes prototyping and applied field tests difficult. Stochastic simulation is a means that allows to simulate complex systems that are affected by randomly occurring events. In this paper, we contribute to the advance of using stochastic simulation to support DLT application engineering processes by 1) presenting a structured approach in applying stochastic simulation, that is also configurable depending on individual evaluation goals, 2) use hypothesis tests to assess the model quality of the Ethereum block generation process, when using homogeneous Poisson processes and 3) discuss concrete measures that help assessing the feasibility of implementing an application on the Ethereum blockchain, which is demonstrated for German waterway transportation processes.

articleTitle: Structural Equation Model on Attracting and Catching SCOTINOPHARA COARCTATA using an Alternative Light Trap via Light Emitting Diodes
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: Scotinophara Coarctata (Rice black bugs) pose risk to Philippine agriculture by decreasing rice production. Reducing rice black bugs through pesticides have risks to farmers, therefore, light traps are being used as an alternative to catch the said pest. Different kinds of light are currently being used in traps including vapor, incandescent, UV, and Light emitting diode -based lamps, which pose varying catch index given different attributes. In this study, a LED (Light-emitting diode)-based light trap prototype was used. Rice black bugs had been caught in selected nights between December 2018 to January 2019 in a specific rice field area in the Philippines. Results had been analyzed using the different LED attributes and external factors affecting the catch index. The catch size was treated dependent on attributes including: the onset and offset of the full moon, the different LED colors or wavelengths (white, blue, UV, yellow and green) and the LED illuminance. The relationship between different attributes and factors had been examined and a structural equation model had been defined using different statistical measures to map the relationships. Results of the analyses had shown higher catch index occurs with a higher light intensity regardless of attributes and factors. Results had also shown higher catch with the use of UV type wavelength LEDs, and a strong positive correlation between the wavelength and the offset of full moon. These indicate that an alternative light trap can be further developed using LEDs for attracting rice black bugs with a higher intensity and UV wavelength.

articleTitle: Preface AIBT 2021
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: The 2021 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT2021) was held during December 4-6, 2021 in the format of virtual conference (online platform, Zoom) due to the situation of Covid-19 and the implementation of worldwide travel restriction. This year, the conference brings together participants consisting of researchers, scientists, students, professionals from all over the world. It lasted for three days including online testing for Zoom basic functions, nine guest speeches, two workshops and eight oral parallel sessions. Topics ranges from Algorithm Design and Calculation; Modern Information Theory and Technology; Artificial Intelligence and Engineering Application; Blockchain Theory and Application and so on. The Proceedings of AIBT 2021 contains 22 papers which were compiled from the excellent papers submitted and presented in the conference. We do hope that this proceeding could share bright ideas and give noteworthy contribution in the field Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology.
